name: web-3d-podium-department-store-homepage
title: Podium Product Display Store Homepage
whatItIs: A store homepage on a mustard backdrop with a dark green top bar, a light blue hero where products (bags, luggage, electronics, snacks) sit on stacked yellow podiums, a bold green headline and a row of colorful category tiles below.
whatItMeans: Staged products on podiums feel like a showroom, and the blue, yellow and green palette is cheerful and approachable for a broad shopping audience.
techniques: Cut-out products arranged on stepped platforms as a hero illustration
Deep green type and buttons as the anchor against pastel color
Category tiles each with its own saturated background color
Utility bar for promo and language above the nav
Simple flat sky and ground planes behind the podiums
bestFor: Campaign landing pages with many product types

vocabulary.definition: Products arranged on stepped blocks as if in a display.
A colorful card that links to a product category.
A thin strip above the nav for promos and settings.
